title: Messages between local sessions
summary: Other Claude sessions on this PC can message this one, used by handoffs and setup-change notices.
details: Other Claude sessions on this PC can send messages into this one, and it is what handoffs and setup-change notices use to hand work over. It is for running more than one session at a time. It changes one settings key (crossSessionInbound set to accept) in settings.json; no code runs and no network is used, and only local sessions on this machine can reach it.
risk: Settings only. Local sessions on this PC can send messages into this session.
